page.layout: Running head "INDEX X." centred at top; two parallel columns of index entries with page numbers at right of each entry; left column first, then right column. No margin notes, no footer.

page.notes: Two columns; the left column ends with a continuation line that is set across into the right column. Page signature "H 3" appears at the foot of the right column, beside "ratur.". Ink and damage make some digits uncertain (e.g. "55" for Ambiorgis, "5s" as printed). Some words in the left column read with doubtful letters, notably "dignißimi" and "subiecti" which may be affected by the smudge. The left column's last entry is "quam res vlla, quam." with the number missing, and the right column's first line "nis optabilis" begins a fragment.
